Class ReadOptions

java.lang.Object
org.apache.opendal.ReadOptions
public class ReadOptions extends Object
Options for a single read or a compatibility input stream. Version selection and conditions require service support and apply to every chunk. Unsupported conditions fail with Unsupported; a failed condition on an existing file fails with ConditionNotMatch. Optional reference fields default to null. Invalid execution values fail with ConfigInvalid; an Instant outside the Rust core timestamp range fails with Unexpected.

  • Field Details

    • offset

      public final long offset
      Starting byte offset. Must be non-negative; defaults to zero.

    • length

      public final long length
      Number of bytes to read. The default of -1 reads to the end; zero selects an empty range.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • version

      public final String version
      Selects a stored file version instead of the current one. This is not a condition. Requires service support for reading versions; a missing version fails with NotFound.

    • ifMatch

      public final String ifMatch
      Reads only when the file has this exact ETag. Requires service support for if-match reads. Only concrete ETags are portable; a wildcard such as "*" has no portable meaning.

    • ifNoneMatch

      public final String ifNoneMatch
      Reads only when the file exists with a different ETag. Requires service support for if-none-match reads. Only concrete ETags are portable; "*" has no portable meaning.

    • ifVersionMatch

      public final String ifVersionMatch
      Reads only when the file has this exact version. Requires service support for version-match reads. This checks the selected file's identity rather than selecting a stored version.

    • ifVersionNotMatch

      public final String ifVersionNotMatch
      Reads only when the file exists with a different version. Requires service support for version-not-match reads.

    • ifModifiedSince

      public final Instant ifModifiedSince
      Reads only when the file was modified after this time. Requires service support for if-modified-since reads.

    • ifUnmodifiedSince

      public final Instant ifUnmodifiedSince
      Reads only when the file was not modified after this time. Requires service support for if-unmodified-since reads.

    • concurrent

      public final int concurrent
      Maximum number of internal chunk requests executed concurrently. Must be positive. This is not the number of application transfers or Java threads and only affects chunked reads.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • chunk

      public final long chunk
      Target size of each internal range request, in bytes. A positive value enables chunked reads. The default of -1 keeps unchunked streaming. Zero and other negative values are invalid. The value must fit the native platform's unsigned pointer-sized integer.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • contentLengthHint

      public final long contentLengthHint
      Known full object content length in bytes, independent of the requested range. The default of -1 means unknown; zero is valid for an empty object. This hint can avoid a metadata request and is not a consistency condition. An incorrect hint can cause incomplete reads or errors. Values below -1 are invalid.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • overrideContentType

      public final String overrideContentType
      Overrides the Content-Type response header when the service supports it. Also applies to presigned read requests.

    • overrideCacheControl

      public final String overrideCacheControl
      Overrides the Cache-Control response header when the service supports it. Also applies to presigned read requests.

    • overrideContentDisposition

      public final String overrideContentDisposition
      Overrides the Content-Disposition response header when the service supports it. Use this to set a download filename on a presigned read request.
